create_parameterized_test: create a parameterized unittest test case using the parameters decorator with multiple argument tuples
create_named_parameterized_test: create a parameterized test using named_parameters decorator with descriptive string names for each test case
build_parameterized_test_class: build a TestCase subclass that inherits from parameterized.TestCase to enable parameterized test generation
create_coop_test_case: create a cooperative test case base class using CoopTestCase to combine with other metaclass-based test bases
run_parameterized_test: run a parameterized test method decorated with parameters that expands into multiple isolated test invocations
